subject: Economics
title: Impact of a change in terms of trade

stages.name: Terms of trade: impact on the current account and living standards
stages.title: Impact of a change in terms of trade
stages.sub: After this you can explain how a change in the terms of trade feeds through to the current account and to living standards.

steps.q: A country's terms of trade index rises from 100 to 110. What has happened to the price of its exports relative to before?
steps.hint: The terms of trade index is export prices divided by import prices, times 100.

steps.q: The same rise in the index could instead be caused by a different change on the other side of the ratio. What would cause the index to rise if the price of what is sold abroad stayed the same?
steps.right: The price of what is bought from abroad drops
steps.wrong: The price of what is bought from abroad climbs

steps.q: Export prices have risen and import prices have not changed. For the same quantities of goods traded, what happens to the balance between money earned from selling abroad and money spent buying from abroad?
steps.right: It tips in the country's favour
steps.wrong: It stays exactly as it was
